title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan - Demon Capital
native: ぬらりひょんの孫 千年魔京
synopsis: At first glance, Nura Rikuo seems like nothing more than a normal middle-schooler. In actual fact, he is grandson of Nurarihyon, master of a youkai clan. Having only recently resolved the hostilities between the Nura Clan and the Shikoku Yokai, Rikuo finds no rest as an ancient enemy of the Nura Clan, Haguromo-Gitsune, resurfaces. After 400 years of inactivity, Haguromo-Gitsune suddenly sweeps through Kyoto with overwhelming power.

episodes.title: The Nura Clan's Third Heir Awakens
episodes.synopsis: Having lost his father at an early age, young Rikuo Nura aspires to become the Supreme Commander of yokai just like his grandfather and late father did.

episodes.title: Two Justice
episodes.synopsis: Ryuji Keikain and Mamiru Keikain, two onmyoji who are powerful enough to take down even Aotabo, have arrived in Ukiyoe Town.

episodes.title: Yura's Realization
episodes.synopsis: Ryuji Keikain uses his Shikigami “Gyogen” to attack Rikuo, who defends himself with his blade. Ryuji halts his attack when he recognizes the blade as “Nenekirimaru,” a Spirit Blade that can only cut down yokai.

episodes.title: Nurarihyon and Princess Yo
episodes.synopsis: During the era when the Toyotomi clan ruled Japan, there lived a young woman known as Princess Yo, who could heal any wound or disease with her magical powers.

episodes.title: Towards Today
episodes.synopsis: Nurarihyon enters Osaka Castle to rescue Princess Yo from Hagoromo-Gitsune.

episodes.title: The Legends of Tono
episodes.synopsis: Kiyotsugu proposes that the Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol members visit Yura's home in Kyoto as part of a summer yokai research project.

episodes.title: Kyokasuigetsu
episodes.synopsis: At Oshu-Tono's Hidden Village, Rikuo spends his days in intense training.

episodes.title: Hagoromo-Gitsune Kyoto Invasion
episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto, the Keikain seals are broken one after another by Hagoromo-Gitsune.

episodes.title: The Grey Onmyoji
episodes.synopsis: Rikuo completes his training and returns to Ukiyoe Town with the Tono-Yokai. Seeing the progress his grandson has made, Nurarihyon allows Rikuo to go to Kyoto.

episodes.title: Hagun
episodes.synopsis: Yura and Ryuji are forced to fight Akifusa.

episodes.title: Battle Above Kyoto
episodes.synopsis: The Kyoto Yokai are moments away from fulfilling their long-standing wish with only one seal remaining to break. Meanwhile, Rikuo and his clan members on board the Treasure Ship are about to enter Kyoto.

episodes.title: Long-Standing Wish
episodes.synopsis: The Nura clan's Treasure Ship sustains heavy damage by the Kyoto yokai and begins to lose altitude.

episodes.title: Torii Labyrinth
episodes.synopsis: At Fushime-Inari Shrine, Awashima the Amanojaku falls into a trap set by the Kyoto yokai 27-Faced-Senju-Mukade.

episodes.title: An Ayakashi to Avoid
episodes.synopsis: Having reunited with Yura, Rikuo is introduced to Hidemoto Keikain, the 13th Heir.

episodes.title: Descent Into Darkness
episodes.synopsis: Rikuo is left severely beaten by Tsuchi-Gumo, when Gyuki arrives to take him to Mt. Kurama for treatment.

episodes.title: Shared Past
episodes.synopsis: Hagoromo-Gitsune takes up residency in Nijo castle, having destroyed all eight of the onmyoji seals.

episodes.title: Equipping a Hundred Demons
episodes.synopsis: As the battle in Kyoto intensifies, the Keikain onmyoji and the Nura clan yokai realize that only by working together can they become a match against the Kyoto yokai.

episodes.title: Entrust It All to Me
episodes.synopsis: During his training with Gyuki, Rikuo learns that by accepting his human side, and believing in his allies, he can become stronger.

episodes.title: A Bond of Trust
episodes.synopsis: The battle between Rikuo and Tsuchi-Gumo reaches its climax. Meanwhile, Nurarihyon enters Nijo Castle to confront Hagoromo-Gitsune for the first time in 400 years.

episodes.title: The Cycle of Rebirth
episodes.synopsis: Hagoromo-Gitsune is about to give birth inside Nijo Castle’s Nuegaike pond. Rikuo and his allies race to stop Hagoromo-Gitsune from giving birth

episodes.title: Birth
episodes.synopsis: Hagoromo-Gitsune has given birth to her son, Nue, and the Kyoto yokai rejoice.

episodes.title: Fragments of the Past
episodes.synopsis: Rikuo is overwhelmed by Hagoromo-Gitsune’s full power in her Nine-Tail form.

episodes.title: Banquet of Darkness
episodes.synopsis: Abeno Seimei has been resurrected back into this world. With the Devil’s Blade in his hand, Seimei proclaims that he will build a demon capital.

episodes.title: Rikuo's Declaration
episodes.synopsis: In order to defeat the powerful Abe no Seimei, the Nura clan yokai and Tono yokai entrust their power of a Hundred Demons to Rikuo.
